children: GP Investments Gains Board-Seat Right at Zevia with 16.1% Stake

GP Investments, Ltd., through its controlled affiliate Bubble Holdings, LLC, reported a Zevia PBC investment representing 16.1% of the company’s Class A shares on an as-converted basis. On October 22, 2026, Bubble paid $15 million for preferred shares and agreed to invest another $5 million if certain conditions are met or waived. The investment gives Bubble the right to designate a Zevia director while it meets specified ownership thresholds.

Bubble acquired the preferred shares for investment purposes and can convert them into Zevia Class A shares. The initial purchase covered 15,000 preferred shares; another 5,000 could follow if Zevia meets 2026 sales and earnings targets, or if Bubble waives those conditions or chooses an early closing. While Bubble and its affiliates meet the ownership threshold, Bubble can designate one director to Zevia’s board.

The agreement limits Bubble’s voting freedom on shares above a set threshold and restricts additional share purchases, takeover proposals and efforts to control Zevia while Bubble holds at least 5%. It also generally restricts transfers for 12 months. The preferred shares accrue a 6% annual dividend and carry rights to convert into Class A shares, subject to adjustment and a stated share cap.

GP Investments, Ltd. is a Bermuda limited liability company whose business includes purchasing, holding and selling securities for investment. GP Investments owns GP Cash Management, Ltd., which has voting control over Bubble Holdings, LLC. The three entities filed jointly and described their investment activity as holding securities for investment purposes.
